7084-7705-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

413-1278-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
413-1278-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
413-1278-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. When it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7201-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7201-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Sapling Nursery and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sapling Nursery triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1496-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

277-880-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1308-3129-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Primal Vigor.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-3129-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

4131-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
4131-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Basalt Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Gigantoplasm and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2146-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1303-3249-5173-6797.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7725.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
5078-5243-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1806-2060-5231-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2921-3764-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3967-4976-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-4976-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1274-3197-4321-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-4321-6830.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5626-6415-6798.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

136-4067-5116-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

500-3125-4826-4867-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
500-3125-4826-4867-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Cormela token, adding {R}.
When the Cormela token dies, it triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, entering untapped due to Archelos.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Cormela triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

527-3812-6287.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Simic Ragworm and Selvala are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
527-3812-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {5}{G}{U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1170-1954-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{W} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "White"
1170-1954-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to cast white monocolored spells.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Throne of Eldraine. Choose "White" as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Change of Heart, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

813-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Scholar of the Ages each turn.
813-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Scholar of the Ages from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2403-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2403-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2043-4659.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of any artifact you control that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Widespread Thieving

947-1132-1305-4753.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving and Clever Impersonator trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

372-1430-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Mirror Image to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Mirror Image leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mirror Image and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

1132-1308-1462-1594-4761.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {W}{U}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

824-3062-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.
824-3062-4474.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a counter from a creature you control, and putting two of that type of counter on another target creature.
Repeat.
